name: server
description: Backend server for the e-commerce system selling electronic components and devices

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm copy:assets && concurrently -k -n tsc,node "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --watch-path=dist dist/src/server.js"
scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=src/database/prisma/schema.prisma && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm copy:assets
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate --schema=src/database/prisma/schema.prisma && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm copy:assets
scripts.docker:up: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && docker compose --env-file .env.docker up -d"
scripts.docker:down: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && docker compose --env-file .env.docker down"
scripts.docker:import: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && grep -v GTID_PURGED src/database/migrations/defaultdb_2026-06-01_142319.sql | docker exec -i digitale-mysql mysql -uroot -pdigital_e_root defaultdb"
scripts.docker:seed: wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -c "cd /mnt/e/Code/digital-e-shop/server && DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=3307 DB_USER=root DB_PASSWORD=digital_e_root DB_NAME=defaultdb DATABASE_URL=mysql://root:digital_e_root@localhost:3307/defaultdb MOCK_ORDER_COUNT=50 MOCK_REVIEW_COUNT=50 node src/database/seeders/seedMockOrdersReviews.js"
scripts.docker:setup: pnpm docker:up ; pnpm docker:import ; pnpm docker:seed
scripts.docs:open: echo Open http://localhost:4000/docs in your browser
